### ① Derived judgments

- The step (`skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` §0 Preflight, after "Make the work reviewable"): three commands. The eleven-name `npx skills remove … -y` list is byte-identical to `content/docs/upgrading.mdx:108–110` on `main` (read in this act), so the skill and the site read the same, and the prose names the two facts beside it (a missing name is skipped; `--all` when these are the project's only skills) — the devx pointer's measurement (`Found 11 / removed 10` on a 17.4.0 project; `objectstack-pm-dispatch` was in the 17.0–17.4 catalog). The install line is the catalog at the installed spec's version (ruling A: the catalog moves with the `@objectstack/*` packages). The sync line `npx skills@1.7.2 experimental_sync --agent claude-code --copy -y` is the scaffolder's printed form: `packages/create-objectstack/src/skills-install.ts:102` `SKILLS_CLI = 'skills@1.7.2'`, `:119` `${SKILLS_CLI} experimental_sync --agent ${agent} --copy -y`, `:131` `skillsInstallHint` = `npx …` (the RUN form at `:127` adds npx's own `-y`); `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx:24` carries the same spelling. The one "why" sentence (`skills-lock.json` entries from `skills add` read `sourceType: github`; the sync skips them, exit 0) is the card's measured premise from PR #23248. Correct.
- The READMEs (`skills/README.md`, shipped as `dist/skills/README.md`; `packages/skills/README.md`, the npm page): the unpinned linked sync becomes the pinned `--copy` spelling above, each with one sentence of why (links into `node_modules`, which a clone does not have; real files in `.claude/skills/` to commit). The linked form is dropped, not kept. `packages/skills/README.md`'s existing scaffolded-project paragraph (remove first — `--all` or by name — then steps 1 and 2) is unchanged and is the pointer's `--all` alternative. The generated index block of `skills/README.md` is untouched (the diff touches lines 5–21; `check:skill-docs` runs in `Lint & Repo Gates`). Correct.
- The ratchet payment. The step costs 815 bytes (~204 tokens, more than the dispatch's 60–100 estimate because the eleven names alone are 234 bytes); six same-file deletions pay it and the file reads 6180 → 6172 tokens against a 6188 ceiling, 485 → 484 lines, no ceiling moved. Each deleted sentence is a restatement whose home I read on the head: (1) the Quickstart connective "Everything below is the long form…" — the four `# N ·` comments and `## N ·` headings; (2) "Below the floor, upgrade to it by the older route first" — the `MigrationFloorError` row "Upgrade to the floor by an older route first" (present); (3) "Porting the edits left unwritten is yours… use `--out` as the oracle" — Failure-modes rows "Pass `--write`, or port the printed edits by hand" and "Diff against `--out`", and "One `conversionId` per commit" (all present); (4) the first R2 trap bullet — §2.2's "keeps compiling while reading `undefined`" and the row "Exercise the path for real" (both present), the surviving bullet folded into one sentence; (5) "Fixing the project's standing lint debt may be a welcome side-effect…" — the same paragraph's "a **pre-existing** project-quality issue, not upgrade residue" and the row "Pre-existing findings are not this upgrade's scope" (present); (6) "Run both. A report that cites only `validate`…" — the call-out's own "`validate` green is necessary and not sufficient" and the Quickstart's "all four, not three" (both present). None of the deleted phrases has a hit in the skill's `references/` or `evals/` on `main`. Read from the loading agent's seat: the file gains one operational step a 17.x → 18 upgrader needs and loses only sentences it still says — value density up.
- `Fixes #23276` is the body's only closing keyword (the body names #22649, #23248, #23275, #23295 with no closing verb); `Clause-②: no` is correct — text only, no spec path, no `content/docs/**`, no `packages/create-objectstack/**`.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/23276-upgrade-skill-skills-step.md` — `"@objectstack/skills": patch`. Correct: the catalog's `SKILL.md` and `dist/skills/README.md` ship in the tarball and `README.md` is the npm page (`files`: `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`); no `skip-changeset`. Each sentence of the changeset is judged against the diff in the ACCEPT on the card (prose face).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag — the step cost ~204 tokens, not the dispatch's 60–100; paid by six deletions, not one or two. The dispatch's estimate was a mechanism assumption and was falsified as the dispatch asked; the payment is judged above. Accepted.
- Dev flag — three gates NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, no whole-workspace `dist/`): `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (derived) and `check:published-readme-exports` (card-named): `Lint & Repo Gates` is `success` on this head and runs them; neither README carries an import. Accepted.
- Dev flag — `origin/main` (`18cd410dc4`) merged before the sweep on the tool's stale-tree flag; the 68 derived commands were identical before and after. Accepted.
- Dev flag — both README budgets used in full (+2 / +2), so the eleven-name list lives only in the skill step while the npm README keeps its `--all` / by-name sentence. Accepted: the site, the skill and the README agree.
- Two reviewer-decidable wordings the dev left to the maintainer (eleven names primary vs `--all` primary; a Quickstart comment line for the step, ~15 tokens): the seat's reading is to keep both as they are — the eleven names are the site's spelling and the Quickstart block already says "all four, not three" of the acceptance; the 速读 shows the maintainer the two options in one line each.

## 维护者速读(终稿)· PR #23366 · head `441106662a` · Tier H(`skills/**`)

skills 席 1(`session_013zGKMG1cRedVzWtqGGGZW9`,huangyiirene),写于 2026-10-14T02:11Z。席内契约复核 PASS 记录在本 PR,ACCEPT 在卡 #23276;本 PR 保持 draft,⛔ 席位不翻 ready、不入队。

### 改了什么

对外发布的升级技能 `objectstack-upgrade` 的「0 · 预检」多了一步:17.x 项目的 AI 技能是用 `skills add` 从仓库 `main` 装的,`skills-lock.json` 里记为 `sourceType: github`,新的同步命令会静默跳过它们(退出码 0),于是只升包不升技能的项目,`.claude/skills/` 里仍是 17.x 的技能文本。这一步先删掉 17.x 目录曾含的十一个 `objectstack-*` 技能(与官网升级页逐字节同一份名单;没装的名字会被跳过;只装了这些技能的项目可用 `--all`),再按已装 `@objectstack/spec` 的版本安装 `@objectstack/skills`,最后用脚手架同一条钉版本、带 `--copy` 的命令复制进代理目录。随 `@objectstack/skills` 发布的两份 README(目录首页与 npm 页面)把未钉版本、生成软链接的同步命令换成这条拼写,并说明为何要 `--copy`(软链接指向 `node_modules`,克隆后是悬空链接)。附一个 patch changeset。`content/docs/**` 与脚手架源码一字未动。

### 为什么改

你在 #22649 的裁决 A:技能目录随 `@objectstack/*` 一起装、一起升,GitHub 路径只是 `next` 渠道;你 10 月 13 日在本席聊天里要求评估升级到 v18 后的技能安装流程与文档,并同意立这张卡。升级手册此前对技能只字未提(实测 grep 为 0 行),升级者按手册走完,技能文本停在 17.x 且同步静默跳过;十一个名字来自 devx 席在 17.4.0 项目上的实测(十个名字删了十个、找到十一个,`objectstack-pm-dispatch` 留在原地)。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

- 纯文本改动,无行为变化。代价全在技能文件的 token 棘轮:该文件此前只剩 8 个 token 余量,这一步要约 204 token(十一个名字本身就 234 字节,比卡上估的 60–100 多),用同文件六处「别处已有原话」的句子抵掉——六处的落点我在当前 head 上逐句核过都在,删掉的句子在技能的 references/evals 里也没有引用;未折行、未抬上限,落地后余量 16。两份 README 各净增 2 行,恰在认领给的预算上。
- 回滚 = revert 本 PR;changeset 未被消费前删除即无痕。本地未测到的三族门禁(`dts-closure`、`dual-build-cjs-loads`、`published-readme-exports`)要全仓构建,CI 的 Lint & Repo Gates 在本 head 上已绿。

### 席位意见

同意落地。① 三处文本与脚手架、官网一种拼写,这是裁决 A 的终态;② 整包价值密度上升:多了升级者真正需要的一步,少的只是复述。两处 dev 留给你的措辞,席位意见都是「保持现状」:删除名单以十一个名字为主、`--all` 为备(与官网一致;若你更想以 `--all` 为主,一句话,席位代改并把约 150 字节退还棘轮);Quickstart 的 `# 0 · preflight` 块不另点名这一步(长文 §0 有;要加约 15 个 token,需再删一句复述)。另记两条不立卡的观察:§0 仍钉着「支持地板 16」这个该技能自己告诫不要记死的数字(下次改此文件时顺手);`packages/skills/README.md` 与 skills-reference 里「Through 18.0.0-next.0 …」一句在 create-objectstack 发布新版后过期(随 Version Packages 发布处理)。

### 你要做的

一个动作:对本 PR **Approve**(`skills/**` 是 Tier H,需要你一次授权批准;批准后席位经中继落地)。若要改成 `--all` 为主或加 Quickstart 一行,在 PR 上留一句,席位续派补丁轮。
